bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to elections; prohibiting political subdivisions from establishing or enforcing ranked-choice voting; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 200.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[200.025] RANKED-CHOICE VOTING; PROHIBITION.

Subdivision 1.

Federal and state offices.

Ranked-choice voting, or any voting method similar to ranked-choice voting, must not be the method of voting for any federal or state office.

Subd. 2.

Local offices.

(a) A political subdivision must not adopt or enforce in any manner a rule, resolution, or ordinance establishing ranked-choice voting as a method of voting, or any voting method similar to ranked-choice voting, for local offices within the political subdivision.

(b) For purposes of this subdivision, "political subdivision" includes all counties, cities, townships, and school districts in the state, regardless of whether governed by statute or by home rule charter.

Subd. 3.

Definition.

For purposes of this section, "ranked-choice voting" means any election method in which a voter ranks or assigns a numerical value to candidates for an office in order of the voter's preference.
additions: Ranked-choice voting, or any voting method similar to ranked-choice voting, must not be the method of voting for any federal or state office.

(a) A political subdivision must not adopt or enforce in any manner a rule, resolution, or ordinance establishing ranked-choice voting as a method of voting, or any voting method similar to ranked-choice voting, for local offices within the political subdivision.

(b) For purposes of this subdivision, "political subdivision" includes all counties, cities, townships, and school districts in the state, regardless of whether governed by statute or by home rule charter.
For purposes of this section, "ranked-choice voting" means any election method in which a voter ranks or assigns a numerical value to candidates for an office in order of the voter's preference.
